profile_text.body:
Mila is a Montreal-based nonprofit artificial intelligence research institute founded in 1993 and headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The institute brings together researchers from Université de Montréal, McGill University, Polytechnique Montréal, and HEC Montréal, forming a community of more than 1,400 researchers specializing in machine learning.

The institute operates several programs supporting AI development and adoption. It runs a year-round program that supports AI startups with cutting-edge resources and tailored development assistance. Mila also offers a policy program, developed with the Public Policy Forum, designed to equip policy and decision makers with tools to navigate AI opportunities and risks, with the next cohort scheduled for French-language delivery on September 1-2, 2026. Research activities span areas including generative retrieval systems and climate-driven ecosystem monitoring, while a venture arm invests in founders building in deep tech, AI, and STEM fields.
